newsitem.title: GERMANY: Shots heard from bank where German hostages held.
newsitem.headline: Shots heard from bank where German hostages held.

text.p: Shots were heard on Saturday from inside a German bank where a man has been holding six people hostage since Fd.

A police spokesman said several shots had been heard at the bank in Neuenstein, near Heidelberg in southwestern Germany, but he did not believe the man had been aiming at his captives and that negotiations with him were continuing.
